name: @kickside/research-ui
title: Research
description: Research page web component for kickside/research — submit a topic, results arrive in the inbox.

wippy.description: Render the Research module-owned Wippy surface inside a host application. Load it by its registered custom-element tag, pass only the documented properties when selecting or editing a resource, and listen for its typed events when the host must navigate, refresh, or accept a value. The component uses the injected Wippy proxy for authenticated APIs and remains isolated inside its Shadow DOM.
